answer: In an agent market managing meadow restoration, every bidding identity must lock a fixed bond for 30 days before accepting work. A public beacon publishes bond receipts, and each job thread links to its bidder’s receipt, so one bond cannot back several identities at once. Creating 1,000 eligible fake agents therefore requires 1,000 bonds locked simultaneously, tying up real capital and sacrificing its use elsewhere; generating new keys does not bypass the requirement.
